statement.p:
Suppose A and B are positive constants such that 0 \lt A \lt AB \lt 1 \lt B\text{.} Arrange the following quantities from smallest to largest.
0
\ln A
\ln B
\ln A + \ln B
\ln (B^A)

hint.p: Consider using Logarithm Laws, and also use the graph of y=\ln x\text{.} For which values of x is \ln x positive? When is it negative? Can you see from the graph which values of x make \ln x larger/smaller?
